title: scaffold-e2e: "Scaffold with repo dist" installs the generated project from this checkout's packed tarballs
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYtTDvfPQDzMbZnN5X

③ maintainer-directed task · Source: maintainer — Bill (os-bill), decision card in seat 5's project thread, 2026-11-26T05:27Z, option verbatim 「先等，并立卡改检查」 (card text: 「模板保持和起步应用一致，改动停到第一个 19 预发布版发出；同时立一张受管卡，让检查改用本仓库打出的包，以后不再被旧版本卡住。」). Ruling record: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/36945#issuecomment-7183516548 · analysis: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/36945#issuecomment-7182816947

Parent: #36945 · Governed surface: `.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml` ⇒ Tier H; contract-tier build and review. Suggested `domain:devx` (triage's to set); grade is triage's.

## Why

During changeset pre mode the repo version (18.6.0) stays the npm `latest`, so the job `Scaffold with repo dist` resolves a generated project's `@objectstack/*` deps to the published 18.6.0, which rejects shapes `main` already ships (object `color`, `fieldGroups[].fields`, object-form `relatedLists`). PR #37428 (#36945) is red for that reason alone, and every template change during a long pre mode hits the same wall. The `next` snapshot is not an answer: ADR-0125's 2026-11-05 amendment refuses snapshots in pre mode until 19 GA.

## Scope

1. The job `Scaffold with repo dist` installs the generated project from this checkout's packed tarballs through the project's own overrides, reusing `scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs` as `os-create-smoke.yml` does.
2. The `latest` fallback and the `engines.protocol` re-stamp in the install step are removed.
3. Unchanged: the pinned-shape step, the skills steps, and the nightly `Registry canary`.
4. In passing: correct the two stale `note.test.ts` comments in the file.

## Acceptance

- PR #37428's head is green on `Scaffold with repo dist` with no template change.
- A control (one template key the workspace spec refuses) is red on the same job.

## Premise clause

The dev re-runs premises 1–9 of the analysis comment before writing. Named, falsifiable premise: a project scaffolded from PR #37428's head validates, builds, tests and boots when its `@objectstack/*` dependencies resolve to the checkout's tarballs. If that does not hold, or if the Docker leg cannot take the packed CLI without a product-visible change under `docker/**`, the dev reports a fork. ⛔ No fallback to installing a snapshot, to tolerating the red, or to changing the template.

## Restart link

#36945 waits as `pm:on-hold`; its `Restart-when:` names this card's merge as one of its two triggers.
